to: nearby in almost all cases: every client whose view holds the entity that `xy_emit` centers on (the actor, the NPC, the seller or the monster). `fishing_none` and `mining_none` go only to the socket of the character. `mheal` rides in the monster `events` of `entities`

payload.type: UiNamed | UiBare | UiFromTo | UiThrow | UiFromTargets | UiBeaconOfResolve | UiArea | UiAbsorb | UiTargetId | UiGatherFail | UiGatherStart | UiGatherNone | UiMluckFind | UiNpcSell | UiNpcBuy | UiResale | UiTrade | UiSwap | UiItemSent | UiGoldSent | UiCxSent | UiResist | UiRestoreMp | UiMlevel | UiDisengage | UiMheal | UiSlots | UiWheel | UiCaveEnter

confirm.note: Every emit of `ui` is cited on its variant (grep of `"ui"` in node/ and node/logic/); `xy_emit` sends the object unchanged.

variants.name: Name only
variants.when: `level_up`: the character reached a new level. `dampened`: a field generator stopped a `blink` or a magiport of the character. The others: the character used that skill (`track`, `magiport` on the safe PvE path, `alchemy`, and the merchant buffs `mcourage`, `mfrenzy`, `massproduction`, `massexchange` and their `pp` forms).

variants.name: Type only
variants.when: A priest used `darkblessing`, or a warrior used `warcry`. The payload does not tell who used it (see Notes).

variants.name: From one to one
variants.when: A character used `mluck`, `rspeed`, `reflection`, `energize`, `4fingers`, or `entangle` (also for the `tangle` skill) on a target.

variants.name: Throw
variants.when: A merchant used `throw`.

variants.name: Paladin support
variants.when: A paladin used `cleansing_light` or `guardians_oath`.

variants.name: Beacon of Resolve
variants.when: A paladin used `beacon_of_resolve` (with `from`), or a paladin cavalry NPC gave the condition (with `name`).

variants.name: Area skill
variants.when: A character used `agitate`, `stomp`, `scare`, `cleave`, `shadowstrike` or `fanofknives`. A `cave_sentinel` in the Cave of Many Dreams also sends `stomp`.

variants.name: Absorb
variants.when: A priest used `absorb` on a character.

variants.name: Skill on a monster
variants.when: A ranger used `huntersmark`, or a character used `charm`. A failed `charm` has `fail: true`.

variants.name: Fishing or mining fails
variants.when: The `skill` request for `fishing` or `mining` found no zone of that kind next to the character, or the character moves.

confirm.note: `request_id` is `data.request_id`, so JSON drops it when the request had none.

variants.name: Fishing or mining starts
variants.when: The `skill` request for `fishing` or `mining` started the timer of the skill.

variants.name: Fishing or mining finds nothing
variants.when: The timer of `fishing` or `mining` ended and the drop gave nothing. Only the socket of the character gets it.

variants.name: Merchant luck
variants.when: A character with the `mluck` condition looted an item from a chest. With a 2% chance, the merchant of that `mluck` got a copy.

variants.name: Sale to an NPC
variants.when: The `sell` request succeeded.

confirm.note: `id` is the `id` of the NPC in `G.maps[map].npcs` (js/old_common_functions.js:233-236).

variants.name: Purchase from an NPC
variants.when: The `buy` request succeeded.

variants.name: Secondhands or lost and found
variants.when: The `sbuy` request bought an item. `+$p`: from `secondhands`. `+$f`: from `lostandfound` (`f` in the request).

variants.name: Player trade
variants.when: `trade_sell` (you sell to a buy order) or `trade_buy` (you buy a listing) succeeded.

variants.name: Trade swap
variants.when: The `trade_swap` request succeeded.

variants.name: Item sent
variants.when: The `send` request with `num` succeeded.

variants.name: Gold sent
variants.when: The `send` request with `gold` succeeded.

variants.name: Cosmetic sent
variants.when: The `send` request with `cx` succeeded.

variants.name: Resist
variants.when: `add_condition` rolled against the resistance of the target (`G.conditions[name].defense`) and the target resisted.

confirm.note: The `type` values are the conditions with `defense` in G 17478.

variants.name: MP restore
variants.when: `consume_mp` rolled the `restore_mp` attribute of the character (for example from Mana Gloves) and won.

variants.name: Monster level
variants.when: `level_monster` ran without `silent`: the monster lived long enough, killed characters, or a monster hunt took a level away.

variants.name: Disengage
variants.when: `stop_pursuit` ran on a monster that stays in the world. A spawned monster disappears instead, unless the stop is a redirect.

confirm.note: Every `stop_pursuit` caller passes `cause` (node/server.js and node/server_functions.js: 17 calls).

variants.name: Monster heal
variants.when: A monster with `self_healing` or `healing` healed. It arrives inside the monster `events` of `entities`, not as its own socket event.

variants.name: Tavern slots
variants.when: The `bet` request with `type: "slots"` started a spin.

variants.name: Tavern wheel
variants.when: The `bet` request with `type: "wheel"` started a spin.

variants.name: Cave entry
variants.when: The start of the entry animation has `names` and `duration`. If the entry then fails, a second event has `key` and `cancel: true`.

UiNamed.summary: A `ui` event about one character: `type` and the name of that character.

fields.name: type
fields.description: What happened.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character.

UiBare.summary: A `ui` event with only `type`: a `darkblessing` or a `warcry`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

UiFromTo.summary: A `ui` event for a skill from one character on one target.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill. The `tangle` skill also sends `"entangle"` (node/server.js:10370-10377).

fields.name: from
fields.description: The character that used the skill.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The target. `entangle`: the `id` of the target (a monster or a character). The others: the name of the target character.

UiThrow.summary: A `ui` event for the `throw` skill: who threw which item at whom.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The character that threw the item.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The `id` of the target.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item that the character threw.

UiFromTargets.summary: A `ui` event for a paladin skill on one friendly character.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The paladin.

fields.name: targets
fields.description: The target character. Always one name.

UiBeaconOfResolve.summary: A `ui` event for `beacon_of_resolve`: the characters that got the condition.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Only from a player: the paladin. The paladin is also in `targets`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Only from a cavalry NPC: the `id` of the NPC (node/logic/cavalry.js:443).

fields.name: targets
fields.description: The characters that got `beacon_of_resolve`. From a player it always has the paladin (`is_same` is true for the same name, node/server_functions.js:506-508). From a cavalry NPC it has at least one name.

UiArea.summary: A `ui` event for an area skill: who used it and the ids that it affected.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character that used the skill. For the `stomp` of a cave sentinel, the `id` of that monster (node/logic/cave_of_many_dreams.js:1482).

fields.name: ids
fields.description: The monsters (and in PvP, the characters) that the skill affected. It can be empty. `fanofknives` lists the targets of its projectiles.

UiAbsorb.summary: A `ui` event for the `absorb` skill: the monsters that now target the priest.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The priest.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The `id` of the `skill` request, as sent: the character whose monsters the priest took.

fields.name: ids
fields.description: The monsters that now target the priest. It can be empty.

UiTargetId.summary: A `ui` event for `huntersmark` or `charm`: who used it and on which target.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character that used the skill.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the target.

fields.name: fail
fields.description: Only on a `charm` that failed. The user also gets the bare `game_response` `charm_failed`.

UiGatherFail.summary: A `ui` event: `fishing` or `mining` did not start.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill name plus `_fail`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Asks the official client to fire a code event.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the `skill` request, echoed. Absent when the request had none.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: `"location"`: no zone of that kind is 24 px up, down, left or right of the character. `"moving"`: the character moves.

confirm.note: `request_id` is `data.request_id`, so JSON drops it when the request had none.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill name plus `_start`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: The side of the zone: `0` down, `1` left, `2` right, `3` up. When more than one side is in the zone, the last match in that order wins (node/server.js:10141-10152).

UiGatherNone.summary: A `ui` event: `fishing` or `mining` ended with no item.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The skill name plus `_none`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Asks the official client to fire a code event.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the `skill` request, echoed. Absent when the request had none.

UiMluckFind.summary: A `ui` event: merchant luck gave a merchant a copy of a looted item.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Merchant luck.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The merchant that got the copy.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The copy. `m` is the name of the character that looted the item.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The inventory slot of the merchant that got the copy.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Asks the official client to fire the code event `mluck`.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `"mluck"`.

UiNpcSell.summary: A `ui` event: a character sold an item to an NPC merchant.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A sale to an NPC.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the NPC, for example `"basics"`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The seller.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item sold. For a stack, `q` is the quantity sold.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The `num` of the `sell` request, as sent: the inventory slot of the item.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `"sell"`.

confirm.note: `id` is the `id` of the NPC in `G.maps[map].npcs` (js/old_common_functions.js:233-236).

UiNpcBuy.summary: A `ui` event: a character bought an item from an NPC merchant.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A purchase from an NPC.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the NPC, for example `"fancypots"`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The buyer.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item bought, with the quantity bought.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `"buy"`.

UiResale.summary: A `ui` event: a character bought an item from `secondhands` or from `lostandfound`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: `"+$p"`: secondhands. `"+$f"`: lost and found.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the NPC.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The buyer.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item, from `cache_item(item, 1)`. It keeps `rid` (5 random characters, node/server_functions.js:613, 645). `cache_item` with `trade` removes `grace` and `src` (node/server_functions.js:4203).

UiTrade.summary: A `ui` event: a sale or a purchase at a merchant stand.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A player trade.

fields.name: seller
fields.description: The character that gave the item.

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: The character that paid.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item, with `q` set to the quantity traded. It has `price`, the gold for one unit. From `trade_buy` it also keeps `rid`.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The trade slot of the listing or the buy order.

fields.name: num
fields.description: From `trade_sell`: the inventory slot of the buyer that got the item. From `trade_buy`: the `num` of the request, unchanged (a server bug: it is not the slot that got the item). Absent when that request has no `num`.

fields.name: snum
fields.description: Only from `trade_sell`: the inventory slot of the seller that the item came from.

UiSwap.summary: A `ui` event: a character accepted a trade offer at a merchant stand.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A trade offer was accepted.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: seller
fields.description: The owner of the stand.

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: The character that accepted the offer.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The listed item, without `want` and `rid` (the server deletes them before the event, node/server.js:9132-9133).

fields.name: received
fields.description: The item that the owner got. For a stack, `q` is the units given.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The trade slot of the offer.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The inventory slot of the buyer that got the listed item.

fields.name: snum
fields.description: The inventory slot of the owner that got the item of the buyer.

UiItemSent.summary: A `ui` event: a character sent an item to another character.

fields.name: type
fields.description: An item was sent.

fields.name: receiver
fields.description: The character that got the item.

fields.name: sender
fields.description: The character that sent the item.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item. `q` is always set: the quantity sent, also `1` for an item that does not stack.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The inventory slot of the receiver that got the item.

fields.name: fnum
fields.description: The inventory slot of the sender that the item came from.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `true`.

UiGoldSent.summary: A `ui` event: a character sent gold to another character.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Gold was sent.

fields.name: receiver
fields.description: The character that got the gold.

fields.name: sender
fields.description: The character that sent the gold.

fields.name: gold
fields.description: The gold that the receiver got. When the two characters have different owners and different IP addresses, the server keeps 2.5% (`parseInt(gold * 0.975)`, node/server.js:8557-8559). It does not take a fee on 1 gold.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `true`.

UiCxSent.summary: A `ui` event: a character sent a cosmetic to another character of the same owner.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A cosmetic was sent.

fields.name: receiver
fields.description: The character that got the cosmetic.

fields.name: sender
fields.description: The character that sent the cosmetic.

fields.name: cx
fields.description: The `cx` of the `send` request: the cosmetic name.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `true`.

UiResist.summary: A `ui` event: an entity resisted a condition.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The condition plus `_resist`. These are the conditions with `defense` in G: `stunned` (`phresistance`), `deepfreezed` and `frozen` (`fzresistance`), `burned` (`firesistance`), `poisoned` (`pnresistance`).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the entity that resisted.

confirm.note: The `type` values are the conditions with `defense` in G 17478.

UiRestoreMp.summary: A `ui` event: a skill gave MP back instead of using it.

fields.name: type
fields.description: MP restore.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The character.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The MP that the character got: two times the MP cost.

UiMlevel.summary: A `ui` event: a monster gained or lost a level.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A monster level change.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the monster.

fields.name: mult
fields.description: `1`: one level up. `-1`: one level down (`delevel`, node/server.js:2656).

UiDisengage.summary: A `ui` event: a monster stopped its attack.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The monster stops.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the monster.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: cause
fields.description: Why, for the log of the official client: `"bored"`, `"player_gone"`, `"scare"`, `"defeat"`, `"exceeds_range"`, `"cant_move"`, `"cant_move_smart"`, `"firecrackers"`, `"warpstomp"`, `"anger"`, `"disengage"`, `"stop()"`, `"kill_monster call"`, or a redirect (`"redirect"`, `"agitate redirect"`, `"absorb redirect"`, `"taunt redirect"`).

confirm.note: Every `stop_pursuit` caller passes `cause` (node/server.js and node/server_functions.js: 17 calls).

UiMheal.summary: A `ui` event: a monster healed itself or another monster.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A monster heal.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the entity that got the HP.

fields.name: heal
fields.description: The HP that the entity got. Poison halves the heal.

UiSlots.summary: A `ui` event: a character spun the slot machine of the tavern.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A slots spin.

fields.name: player
fields.description: The character that plays.

fields.name: stops
fields.description: The stop of each reel: an index into `G.games.slots.reels[reel]`. One number per reel.

fields.name: ms
fields.description: The spin time: `G.games.slots.spin`.

UiWheel.summary: A `ui` event: a character spun the Fortune's Wheel of the tavern.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A wheel spin.

fields.name: player
fields.description: The character that plays.

fields.name: side
fields.description: The side that the character bet on: a value of `G.games.wheel.sides`.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The slice where the wheel stops: an index into `G.games.wheel.slices`. The result is known now; the payout comes when the spin ends.

fields.name: ms
fields.description: The spin time: `G.games.wheel.spin`.

UiCaveEnter.summary: A `ui` event: a party starts to enter the Cave of Many Dreams, or the entry failed.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A cave entry.

fields.name: names
fields.description: Only at the start: the characters that enter.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Only at the start: the length of the animation, always `1800`.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The key of the run: 24 hex characters (node/logic/generated_maps.js:473). On a return to a run, the key of that run.

fields.name: cancel
fields.description: Only when the entry failed after the animation started.

senders.what: `add_item` with `m` (chest loot from `open_chest` and encouragement loot): `+M`.
The `skill` handler: paladin and merchant support skills, `throw`, `entangle`, `4fingers`, `darkblessing`, `warcry`.
The condition timers of a character: `dampened` (`blink` and `magiport` near a field generator).
The `fishing` and `mining` timers: `fishing_none`, `mining_none` (only to the character).
A `cave_sentinel` in the Cave of Many Dreams: `stomp`.
